name: @atproto/lex-client
description: HTTP client for interacting with Lexicon based APIs

scripts.codegen:lex:src: lex-builder build --lexicons ../../../lexicons --out ./src/lexicons --clear --lib @atproto/lex-schema --index-file --default-export --include com.atproto.repo.applyWrites --include com.atproto.repo.createRecord --include com.atproto.repo.deleteRecord --include com.atproto.repo.getRecord --include com.atproto.repo.putRecord --include com.atproto.repo.listRecords --include com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob --include com.atproto.sync.getBlob
scripts.codegen:lex:tests: lex-builder build --lexicons ../../../lexicons --out ./tests/lexicons --clear --lib @atproto/lex-schema --index-file --include app.bsky.* --include com.atproto.repo.applyWrites --include com.atproto.repo.createRecord --include com.atproto.repo.getRecord --include com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob --include com.atproto.sync.getBlob
